questions.question: A man spent 60% of his salary on household expenses, 20% of his salary on rent and out of remaining salary, he donated 80% to a trust. If he is left with ₹20,000, then what is his salary?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining percentage after **expenses** and **rent** = 100% − (60% + 20%) = 20%.

Out of this 20%, he donated 80%, so 20% was left: 20% × 20% = 4% of total salary.

4% of **Salary** = ₹20,000 ⇒ 1% = ₹5,000.

100% **Salary** = ₹5,00,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,00,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f71c5ce8b170d5d22cbd950890bc7d644ff7bee88327b44e49b9a37835d4725.png] 

**Given:**

**Household Expenses** = 60% | **Rent** = 20% | **Remaining** = 100% − 80% = 20%.

**Donation** = 80% of **Remaining** | **Saving** = ₹20,000.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total **Salary** be S.

⇒ **Remaining Salary** after expenses = S × (100 − 60 − 20)% = 0.20S.

⇒ **Final Saving** = **Remaining Salary** × (100 − 80)% = 0.20S × 0.20.

⇒ 0.04S = 20,000.

⇒ S = 20,000 ÷ 0.04.

⇒ S = 5,00,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,00,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When values change sequentially on the remaining balance, the effective factor is product of individual factors: Final = Initial × (1−r₁/100) × (1−r₂/100).

Base Change Property

Always identify if the percentage is applied to the **Total Salary** or the **Remaining Salary** before calculating.

questions.question: A and B can do a work in 10 days and 40 days, respectively. How long will it take together to complete the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct formula for two people working together: **Time = (X × Y) ÷ (X + Y)**.

Here X = 10 days and Y = 40 days.

Combined Time = (10 × 40) ÷ (10 + 40) = 400 ÷ 50 = 8 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **A** = 10 days, **B** = 40 days.

**Formula Used:** **Total Work** = LCM of individual days; **Efficiency** = Total Work ÷ Days.

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

 A
 10
 40 units
 40 ÷ 10 = 4

 B
 40
 40 ÷ 40 = 1

⇒ **Total Efficiency** of (A + B) = 4 + 1 = 5 units/day.

⇒ **Time taken** together = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

⇒ **Time taken** = 40 ÷ 5 = 8 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relation

**Efficiency** is inversely proportional to the **Time** taken to complete a work. If the ratio of time is a:b, the ratio of efficiency is b:a.

Pipes and Cisterns

This concept is identical to **Time and Work**, where an inlet pipe does positive work and a leakage/outlet pipe does negative work.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the **Work Done** by the individuals, which is usually the ratio of their **Efficiencies** if they work for the same duration.</p

questions.question: Two parallel chords on the same side of the centre of a circle are 12 cm and 20 cm long and the radius of the circle is 5√13 cm. What is the distance between the chords?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the first chord = 12 cm

Length of the second chord = 20 cm

Radius of the circle = 5√13 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ed431c5f2b7efda01a6fa2fce18cf2e435451f2093ff8beca5645f5292c8d29.png] 

OB = OD = 5 √13 cm

AB = 12 cm, CD = 20 cm, AM = MB = 12/2 = 6 cm and CN = ND = 20/2 = 10 cm

In Δ MBO

OB2 = MB2 + MO2

⇒ (5 √13)2 = 62 + OM2

⇒ OM2 = 325 – 36 = 289

⇒ OM = √289 = 17

In Δ NDO

OD2 = ND2 + NO2

⇒ (5 √13)2 = 102 + NO2

⇒ ON2 = 325 – 100 = 225

ON = √225 = 15

As we know,

OM = MN + ON

⇒ 17 = MN + 15

⇒ MN = 17 – 15 = 2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: Given that the perimeters of two similar triangles, ∆ABC and ∆DEF, are 24 cm and 9 cm, respectively, and DE = 3 cm, what is the ratio between the area of ∆ABC and that of ∆DEF?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of ∆ABC = 24 cm

Perimeter of ∆DEF = 9 cm

DE = 3 cm

**Formula Used:**

Ratio of areas of similar triangles = (Ratio of perimeters)²

**Calculation:**

Ratio of perimeters = 24 / 9

Ratio of perimeters = 8 / 3

Ratio of areas = (8 / 3)²

Ratio of areas = 64 / 9

**The ratio between the area of ∆ABC and that of ∆DEF is 64 : 9.**

questions.question: What will be the least value of x so that the 5-digit number 627x5 becomes divisible by 9?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5-digit number: 627x5

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule for 9: A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

**Calculation:**

Sum of digits of 627x5 = 6 + 2 + 7 + x + 5

Sum of digits = 20 + x

For 627x5 to be divisible by 9: (20 + x) must be divisible by 9.

from the option:

x = 7, 

Sum = 20 + x = 20 + 7 = 27, it is divisible by 9.

So, the least value of x = 7

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: The ratio of the diameters of two spheres is given as 1 : 4. The larger sphere is melted and 125 identical spheres are made out of the molten material. The smaller sphere is melted and 27 identical spheres are made out of the molten material. If the ratio of the volume of each of the 125 identical spheres to the volume of each of the 27 identical spheres is given as 1 : m, what is the value of m?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of diameters of two spheres = 1 : 4

Number of identical spheres made from the larger sphere = 125

Number of identical spheres made from the smaller sphere = 27

Ratio of the volume of each of the 125 identical spheres to the volume of each of the 27 identical spheres = 1 : m

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³

Volume ratio of spheres = ((d₁)/(d₂))³ 

**Calculation:**

Let the diameter of the smaller sphere be d. Then the diameter of the larger sphere is 4d.

Let the radius of the smaller sphere be r. Then the radius of the larger sphere is 4r.

Volume of the smaller sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³

Volume of the larger sphere = (4)/(3)pi (4r)³

⇒ Volume of the larger sphere = (4)/(3)pi (64r³)

⇒ Volume of the larger sphere = (256)/(3)pi r³

Volume of each of the 125 identical spheres = (frac{256)/(3)pi r³}{125}

⇒ Volume of each of the 125 identical spheres = (256pi r³)/(375)

Volume of each of the 27 identical spheres = (frac{4)/(3)pi r³}{27}

⇒ Volume of each of the 27 identical spheres = (4pi r³)/(81)

Ratio of the volume of each of the 125 identical spheres to the volume of each of the 27 identical spheres = (frac{256pi r³)/(375)}{(4pi r³)/(81)}

⇒ Ratio = (256pi r³)/(375) times (81)/(4pi r³)

⇒ Ratio = (256 times 81)/(375 times 4)

⇒ Ratio = (20736)/(1500)

⇒ Ratio = 1728/125

⇒ Ratio = 1 : m

⇒ m = (125)/(1728)

**The correct answer is Option 3).**

questions.question: A motorcycle covered the first 60 km of its journey at an average speed of 40 km/h. The speed of the motorcycle for covering the rest of the journey, i.e. 90 km, was 45 km/h. During the whole journey, the overall average speed of the motorcycle was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First part distance = 60 km

First part speed = 40 km/h

Second part distance = 90 km

Second part speed = 45 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation:**

Time taken for the first part = Distance / Speed = 60 / 40

Time taken for the first part = 1.5 hours

Time taken for the second part = Distance / Speed = 90 / 45

Time taken for the second part = 2 hours

Total distance = 60 km + 90 km

Total distance = 150 km

Total time = 1.5 hours + 2 hours

Total time = 3.5 hours

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

Average speed = 150 km / 3.5 hours

Average speed = (150)/(3.5)

Average speed = (1500)/(35)

Average speed = 42 (6)/(7) km/h

**The overall average speed of the motorcycle is 42 (6)/(7) km/h.**

questions.question:
Simplify the following expression.

3 + 28 ÷ 35 × 15 + 4 - 3 × 4
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simplify the following expression: 3 + 28 ÷ 35 × 15 + 4 - 3 × 4

**Formula Used:**

Order of Operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS): Parentheses/Brackets, Exponents/Orders, Multiplication and Division (from left to right), Addition and Subtraction (from left to right).

**Calculation:**

Start with the expression: 3 + 28 ÷ 35 × 15 + 4 - 3 × 4

Step 1: Division and Multiplication from left to right.

⇒ 3 + (28 ÷ 35) × 15 + 4 - 3 × 4

⇒ 3 + (0.8) × 15 + 4 - 3 × 4

⇒ 3 + 12 + 4 - 12

Step 2: Addition and Subtraction from left to right.

⇒ (3 + 12) + 4 - 12

⇒ 15 + 4 - 12

⇒ 19 - 12

⇒ 7

**The simplified value of the given expression is 7.**

questions.question: If equation of line p is x + y = 5 and that of line q is x - y = 3, what are the coordinates of the point common to both the lines?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Equation of line p: x + y = 5

Equation of line q: x - y = 3

**Formula Used:**

To find the coordinates of the intersection point, solve the system of equations:

1. x + y = 5

2. x - y = 3

**Calculation:**

Adding equations 1 and 2:

x + y + x - y = 5 + 3

⇒ 2x = 8

⇒ x = 8 / 2

⇒ x = 4

Substituting x = 4 into equation 1:

4 + y = 5

⇒ y = 5 - 4

⇒ y = 1

**Coordinates of the point common to both lines:**

(4, 1)

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks up the price of the oil by 40% and uses a faulty machine which measures 15% less. If the shopkeeper gives a discount of 32%, the profit/loss percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Markup percentage = 40%

Faulty machine measures 15% less

Discount given = 32%

**Formula Used:**

Profit/Loss percentage = (frac{{Selling Price} - {Cost Price}}{{Cost Price}}) times 100 %

**Calculation:**

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100

Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 40% of 100

⇒ MP = 100 + 40

⇒ MP = 140

Due to faulty machine, the quantity measured is 15% less, hence the quantity sold is 85%

⇒ Selling Price (SP) before discount = 140

Discount given = 32% of 140

⇒ Discount = 32% × 140

⇒ Discount = 0.32 × 140

⇒ Discount = 44.8

SP after discount = 140 - 44.8

⇒ SP = 95.2

Effective quantity sold = 85% of CP = 85% of 100

⇒ Effective quantity sold = 85

Profit/Loss = SP - Effective CP

⇒ Profit/Loss = 95.2 - 85

⇒ Profit = 10.2

Profit percentage = ((10.2)/(85)) times 100 %

⇒ Profit percentage = 12%

**The profit percentage is 12%.**

questions.question: In how many years will the simple interest on a sum of money be equal to the principal at the rate of 2(6)/(7) % per annum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When **Simple Interest** equals **Principal**, the product of **Rate** and **Time** must be 100%.

**Rate (R)** = 2 6/7% = 20/7% per annum.

**Time (T)** = 100 ÷ R = 100 ÷ (20/7)

⇒ T = 100 × 7 ÷ 20 = 5 × 7 = 35 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf8decd65849b930d27ecdefc77c8bf16f389b1fb11d91166f1b0fe977281b1f.png] 

**Given:**

**Simple Interest (SI)** = **Principal (P)**

**Rate (R)** = 2 6/7% = (2 × 7 + 6)/7 % = 20/7 % per annum.

**Formula Used:**

**SI** = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ P = (P × (20/7) × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 1 = (20 × T) ÷ (7 × 100)

⇒ 1 = (20 × T) ÷ 700

⇒ 700 = 20 × T

⇒ T = 700 ÷ 20

⇒ T = 35 **years**.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Interest calculated only on the initial principal amount throughout the entire period: **SI = (P×R×T)/100**.

Total Amount

The final value after adding interest to the principal: **A = P + SI = P[1 + (R×T)/100]**.

Interest as a Fraction

If **SI** is 1/n of the **Principal**, then the time period **T** can be directly calculated as **100 / (n×R)**.</p

questions.question: If Arun's salary was decreased by 50% and subsequently increased by 50%, then how much per cent did he lose?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial salary of Arun = S

Decrease in salary = 50%

Subsequent increase in salary = 50%

**Formula Used:**

Final Salary = Initial Salary × (1 - Decrease%) × (1 + Increase%)

Percentage Loss = ((Initial Salary - Final Salary))/(Initial Salary) times 100

**Calculation:**

Decrease in salary = 50% of S = 0.5S

New salary after decrease = S - 0.5S = 0.5S

Subsequent increase = 50% of 0.5S = 0.25S

Final salary after increase = 0.5S + 0.25S = 0.75S

Percentage Loss = ((S - 0.75S))/(S) times 100

Percentage Loss = (0.25S)/(S) times 100

Percentage Loss = 0.25 × 100

Percentage Loss = 25%

**Arun lost 25% of his salary.**

questions.question: A largest possible sphere is carved in a cube of side 14 cm. What is its volume in cm³?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For the **largest sphere** inside a **cube**, the **diameter** of the sphere = **side** of the cube.

Side = 14 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 7 cm.

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³ = (4/3) × (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 7.

Volume = (4 × 22 × 49) / 3 = 4312 / 3 = 1437 (1/3) cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 1437 (1/3) cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Side of cube (a) = 14 cm.

**Formula Used:** Volume of Sphere = (4/3)πr³; Radius of inscribed sphere = a/2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/863a8ced62007582f21674c864be8b97c4ed9934c1bd2b443f5879e4da2ce5fc.png] 

⇒ Side of the **cube** (a) = 14 cm.

⇒ **Diameter** of the **largest sphere** = 14 cm.

⇒ **Radius** (r) = 14 / 2 = 7 cm.

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 7³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 343

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × 22 × 49

⇒ Volume = 4312 / 3

⇒ Volume = 1437 (1/3) cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 1437 (1/3) cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cube properties

Total Surface Area = 6a² and Volume = a³, where 'a' is the side length.

Sphere properties

Surface Area = 4πr² and Volume = (4/3)πr³, where 'r' is the radius.

Cube and Sphere Relationship

For a sphere **circumscribing** a cube, the diameter is equal to the **diagonal** of the cube (√3 a).</p

questions.question: A man walking at the speed of 5 km/h covers a certain distance in 3 hours 45 minutes. If he covers the same distance by a cycle in 2 hours 10 minutes, then the speed of the cycle in km/h is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a constant distance, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time**.

Time 1 (Walk) = 3 h 45 min = 225 min | Time 2 (Cycle) = 2 h 10 min = 130 min

Time Ratio (Walk : Cycle) = 225 : 130 = 45 : 26

Speed Ratio (Walk : Cycle) = 26 : 45

If 26 units = 5 km/h, then 45 units = (5 ÷ 26) × 45 = 225/26 = 8 17/26 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 8(17)/(26) km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Walking speed = 5 km/h, Walking time = 3 h 45 min, Cycling time = 2 h 10 min.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time; Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65991f2b33e4ce7b1c570dc1834573c188d927cb264656aa2f7e3bf9b9099795.png] 

⇒ Walking time = 3 + 45/60 = 3 + 3/4 = 15/4 hours

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time = 5 × (15/4) = 75/4 km

⇒ Cycling time = 2 + 10/60 = 2 + 1/6 = 13/6 hours

⇒ Cycling Speed = Distance ÷ Cycling time = (75/4) ÷ (13/6)

⇒ Cycling Speed = (75/4) × (6/13) = (75 × 3) / (2 × 13) = 225/26

⇒ Cycling Speed = 8 17/26 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 8(17)/(26) km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relation

When distance is constant, Speed₁ × Time₁ = Speed₂ × Time₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60. To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18.

Average Speed

For the same distance covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy/(x + y).</p

questions.question: Mohan gets 12% increase in his sale amount in the first year and 15% increase in the second year, with that his present sale is ₹1,28,800. What was his sale two years ago?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplier for 12% and 15% increase = 1.12 × 1.15 = 1.288

Sale two years ago = Present Sale ÷ Net Multiplier

Sale = 1,28,800 ÷ 1.288 = 1,00,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,00,000.**
